1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 g6 4.O-O Bg7 5.c.strategy: A gambit: White offers the d-pawn, which Black's two pawns and knight attack, to open the centre and trade off Black's central pawns. The compensation is open lines for the pieces and the pressure of the bishop on b5, at the cost of material.
